component.name: ArchStore
component.summary: Arch Linux software store for pacman, AUR and Flatpak
统一管理官方仓库、AUR 与 Flatpak 的 Arch Linux 软件商店

description.p: ArchStore provides a graphical software store for Arch Linux, managing three sources in one place: official repositories (pacman/libalpm), the AUR, and Flatpak.
ArchStore 为 Arch Linux 提供图形化软件商店，统一管理三类软件源：官方仓库（pacman/libalpm）、 AUR 与 Flatpak。它坚持 Arch 的透明可控哲学：任何系统变更都必须先显示计划清单， 经用户显式确认后才由独立的 root 进程（archstore-helper）执行。

ul.li: Search and browse official repositories, the AUR and Flathub
Review every transaction as a declarative plan before it runs
Never runs GTK as root — all privileged work goes through pkexec and a helper binary
Offline-first: cached metadata keeps the app usable without a network
Works without paru/yay or flatpak installed; unavailable sources are greyed out with a reason

description.p: ArchStore 首个版本：pacman / AUR / Flatpak 只读查询、事务计划与提权执行、中文界面。
